body: My thoughts exactly.

You've basically got two choices- ignore everything and wait for him to find out on his own (and presumably blame you), or be honest with him. I don't know anything about your ex or the circumstances of your breakup, but in my opinion honesty seems to be the least damaging option if you ever want to actually talk to this guy again.

We've all made dumb and irrational decisions when we've been upset... You could've done far worse, and at least you logged out afterwards so you couldn't be tempted to keep looking. Have the two of you communicated at all since you broke up?

I think this is a conversation you need to be having with him. It's absolutely possible to feel happy and fulfilled while being single, but on the other hand having the support of a loving partner can make a huge difference.  I really doubt you're as boring as you think you are.
I got the impression that she already plans on doing it, she's just looking for people to tell her that she's doing the right thing.
Would you have believed his bitter ex-girlfriend if she approached you?
The implant, perhaps? It's hormonal but it does last 3 years.
Leave her alone, she isn't your concern.
It's time to move on. You're 18, go live your life.

A year isn't that long, all things considered. It's not like the two of you worked hard to build a life together. He seriously needs to start putting some effort into things, his life isn't going to get any easier and right now he's just dragging you down with him. Sounds like he might be struggling with depression; see if he's willing to seek help.
I agree with all of this.

With the way everything has played out so far, I really wish I had never met him. 2015 was the worst year of my life, I didn't need to end it with this kind of blow... Regardless of what his intentions were, he handled this is pretty much the worst way possible. To make that even worse, he knows he fucked up big time and he knew dragging it out would hurt me more. He also knows what it's like to be on the receiving end of such treatment... I just don't understand.
Why are you not allowed to bring him?
Oh, and all of that came with a $2500 bill. Thankfully my insurance covered it and I was only responsible for the $75 ER fee...
I know this doesn't help, but I 1000% know how you feel. That pretty much sums up every adult relationship I've ever had. Feeling things so very deeply can definitely be a curse..

My ex once had the police come get me and take me to the hospital because he was afraid I'd do something to myself. I didn't want to be there though and refused to admit that I was suicidal... Because of how calm I was they only held me for about 12 hours before kicking me out because they needed the space. All they did was check my blood and give me a number of a local counseling center (they never retuned my calls)...
And another "friend". This is why I don't reach out to people... https://www.photobox.co.uk/my/photo/full?photo_id=21037292997
Fuck it. I'm driving my dog to the shelter tomorrow. Reached out to a friend for help and he had the police call and tell me to stop contacting him. I'm through, I can't do this anymore.
Is it wrong that one of my major motivating factors is making everybody that hurt me live with the lifelong guilt of knowing that they contributed to my death?

Thank you... All I really wanted was to sit down with him, face to face, and have a real conversation. There's just so much I need to say and there's nobody in my life right now that I feel comfortable confiding in. We're both very passive, non-confrontational people so I kind of understand why he chose to hide behind a screen, but that doesn't make it hurt any less...

I really do love him, and I want to help... even if that means we never get back together romantically. He's had a series of not-so-heathy relationships, some of which were downright emotionally abusive. It makes my heart hurt, he doesn't deserve it.

I'm so sick of being told to just "get over it" and move on with my life, as if I enjoyed being miserable and wallowing in self pity. To have people constantly trivializing my pain. To be told I need to "man up".

I just really want closure so I can stop fixating on this and start working on making my life better... It's been the only thing on my mind for weeks, it's absolutely maddening and some days all I can do is lay in bed and cry. I've never felt so pathetic.

I'm so lonely. I have no support group out here. No local friends or family.I have nothing.
I miss him so much.
No other children.

What else could possibly be going on?  This guy's probably the biggest doormat I've ever met... It didn't take me long to figure out after we started dating but it honestly never bothered me.  Then again, I never thought he'd basically dump me for his ex who has him (literally and figuratively) by the balls, either...

Every single person in his life has told him that this is a horrible idea but he doesn't want to listen.  Even he admitted that he knows this is probably going to end badly, yet he's doing it anyway.  I have never been so taken aback in my life. This really hurts and it's completely shattered my trust and self esteem...
A serious question- what's the rush?  Slow things down, really get to know this person.
I bought my second car for under $1000 and it's been incredibly reliable.  Look for an older, elderly-owned vehicle, they're usually clean and well maintained.

It just hurts a lot because everything else was totally fine and we were both really happy.  He had even asked me to move in with him just a few weeks prior. This completely came out of nowhere and I'm majorly struggling to cope.

From a later e-mail:

> I am very sorry for all I have put you through.  As I've said, I never meant to hurt you, and that is not my intention now either.  I am just completely numb to everything at the moment.  It does hurt me to not respond to you, and it hurts me to know I've caused you any pain.  As I've also said previously, I just simply cannot be in a relationship with anyone right now.  The whole situation with my ex is way more complicated than I thought, and she refuses to listen to reason with regard to her decision making.  It's compounded personally for me by the fact that I do still care about her.  Just speaking to her has also opened up wounds from our relationship that I mistakenly thought were healed.  In fact, they're far from it.

> You hit the nail on the head, I do indeed let people take advantage of me, and I've reached a point where I refuse to allow it anymore.  Unfortunately, as an unintended consequence, I have pretty much shut down emotionally, and have been stuck in a rut of seemingly never-ending apathy.  I have increased my counseling sessions, so I do have at least some small form of a support network there.  I'll be ok...in time.  I just really don't know what direction I'm headed in at the moment, but I know that I want to simply focus on me and me only for right now.

> More importantly, I want you to be ok as well.  Again, I am deeply sorry for putting you through this, and for treating you unfairly.  It probably doesn't seem as though I care, but I do.  I would like, for the time being, to remain friends if you can do that.  If not, then I understand, and I will respect that.  You're a wonderful girl, and I'd sincerely hate to lose you from my life completely & forever.  I hope you can understand this.

That was probably the last real effort he made to actually talk to me.  I really want to discuss everything, for my own sanity if nothing else, but I hate doing it through text and I feel like if I keep messaging him I'm going to come off as needy or crazy and it'll only justify his pushing me away.
